patch_description: Introduce a center-edge CRZ layer to replace the center-post RZ gate. This adds center-to-edge CRZ gates that share a single parameter, replacing rz_post_center with crz_center_edge gates, thereby enriching center-edge correlations without increasing parameter count. The change preserves adjacent CZ connectivity and parameter-sharing philosophy, and keeps overall block structure intact. This approach aligns with the suggested center-edge CRZ augmentation to improve expressivity and validation performance.
